title: Hip Artist East Nashville
description:
Ultra Modern one level home in East Nashville 5 miles to downtown Nashville. Luxury pillow top and goose down duvets. Gas stove, stainless appliances, quartz countertops. Wooden flooring throughout. Glass shower and another full bath.
3 bedrooms. 1 king bed and 2 queens. One sleeper couch. 
Large deck and outside yard. Parking for 3 cars. Internett ultra high speed glass fiber from ATT. HULU and Netflix on Roku TVs.

The space
The home is completely updated with open plan living and kitchen area. The floors are wooden sanded and finished and both bathrooms have ceramic tile. The master bathroom has a modern frameless glass shower with rainhead and wall shower heads.
Washer and dryer are in a closet in the living area.
Keurig and coffee are provided. Laundry has laundry soap. Dishwasher with pods. Shampoo, soap, dish soap, towels, linens and extra linens and duvets are provided.
TVs in master bedrooma nd living room.
There is a large deck from the living area. Chsrcoal grill is available. Place is perfect for 
outdoor barbecue.

Guest access
The home is a single family and guests have access to the home and parking on property.
